name: dna-helix-emerald-plexus
description: DNA plexus helix motion graphic (Remotion + Three.js/WebGL2), 4K 30 fps

scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render V1-EmeraldPlexusHelix-4K "out/Version 1 - DNA Emerald Plexus Helix (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v1:1080p: remotion render V1-EmeraldPlexusHelix-4K "out/Version 1 - DNA Emerald Plexus Helix (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render V2-EmeraldPlexusHelixOrbit-4K "out/Version 2 - DNA Emerald Plexus Helix Orbit (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:1080p: remotion render V2-EmeraldPlexusHelixOrbit-4K "out/Version 2 - DNA Emerald Plexus Helix Orbit (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all:4k: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run render:v2:4k
scripts.render:all:1080p: npm run render:v1:1080p && npm run render:v2:1080p
